name: auto-test
description: Runs the project's tests once at the end of a turn in which Claude edited files, and shows a green or red result. Off until you type /auto-test on.

enabled.title: Enable auto-test
enabled.description: Turn off to make /auto-test do nothing (no test is ever run).

command.title: Test command
command.description: Run this instead of the detected test command (pytest, npm test, cargo test, devtools::test(), go test). Empty means detect. /auto-test command <cmd> sets one for the current project and wins over this.

timeoutSec.title: Time limit (seconds)
timeoutSec.description: A test run that takes longer is stopped and reported as could not run.

tellModel.title: Tell Claude when tests fail
tellModel.description: When on, a failed run adds a short note to the conversation so Claude can fix it on your next message. Off by default: nothing is sent to the model.
